item.title: Trump adds drones, snipers and ammunition to plans for Washington triumphal arch
item.description: US President Trump announced plans to transform a proposed triumphal arch into a military complex. This new facility will house and deploy drones and snipers for national security. The structure is planned near Arlington Memorial Bridge, adjacent to the cemetery. Veterans have filed lawsuits challenging the arch's construction and sightline disruption. The Federal Aviation Administration has cleared aviation concerns for the proposed arch.

item.title: Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches
item.description: US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. It highlights ongoing debates about digital device searches at the border.

item.title: Landslide, flash flood kill 6 in Kerala amid heavy rain alert - video
item.description: Tragedy struck Kottakamboor, Kerala, where six lives were lost due to a devastating landslide and flash flood. In response, the India Meteorological Department has issued a warning for increased rainfall across seven districts, including Thiruvananthapuram. With heavy rainfall anticipated for the next 24 hours, an orange alert has been placed for Idukki.
item.dc:creator: ANJALI SINGH

item.title: How Jordon Hudson became an important part of Bill Belichick’s life
item.description: Bill Belichick rarely discusses his personal life, making his comments about Jordon Hudson particularly notable. During a 2025 interview, he praised Hudson as “terrific” and “very helpful,” explaining that she supported him with business matters and his book while he focused on coaching at North Carolina. His remarks offered a glimpse into their relationship, emphasizing companionship, trust, support, and mutual perspective.

item.title: Vince and Linda McMahon net worth 2026: How they built their fortune
item.description: Vince and Linda McMahon built a global sports entertainment empire from a regional wrestling company. Their combined net worth is estimated at $3.2 billion, largely from WWE. WWE merged with UFC in 2023, creating TKO Group Holdings. Vince McMahon retains a significant stake in TKO, while Linda pursued politics. The couple also holds substantial real estate and other investments.

item.title: Meet Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, eighth-grader who designed controlled-release antacid
item.description: An eighth-grade student from Pennsylvania, Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, has become a national finalist for her groundbreaking GERD drug delivery system. She created an innovative controlled release mechanism aimed at prolonging the effectiveness of antacid medications. This recognition follows her success at regional science fairs, and she will vie for educational accolades in Washington, D.C. in October, showcasing her dedication to improving heartburn treatment outcomes.

item.title: 46-year-old man found dead inside luxury car in Bengaluru
item.description: A 46-year-old man was found dead in a high-end vehicle on Sunday morning. Identified as Salim Akbar from Kodagu, he was discovered unresponsive. Initial investigations and security camera footage revealed the car had been parked near a restaurant around 2:30 am. While authorities are awaiting further reports, they suspect health issues may have played a role in the death, with no indications of foul play.
item.dc:creator: ANJALI SINGH

item.title: ‘When do I blow entire nation up?' Trump's ultimatum after Iran warns of 'decisive war'
item.description: President Trump warned Iran of serious consequences if it does not change course. He outlined options including destruction, economic collapse, or diplomacy with Iran. Iran's command stated any US attack would face retaliation without limitations. Iran relayed truce conditions to the US through Qatari mediators. Trump signaled openness to talks with Iranian President Pezeshkian.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Russia wraps up first wartime parliamentary election, Kremlin set to retain control
item.description: Russia's parliamentary elections concluded on Sunday, projecting that the United Russia party will continue to rule. This election was marred by a heavy clampdown on opposition and dissent, alongside controversial voting in Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia. Ukraine condemned these actions, leading to international outcry, as numerous watchdogs deemed the election illegal under global treaties. Results are anticipated soon after the conclusion of voting in western Russia.

item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and US President Trump have agreed to a crucial meeting in New York, coinciding with the UN General Assembly. Zelenskyy thanked the US special envoys for their recent visit to Kyiv. During their discussion, the leaders emphasized the importance of security issues and outlined steps towards de-escalation, signaling a collaborative approach towards a stable future for Ukraine.

item.title: Healthcare goes digital: When doctors go behind the app wall, who gets left behind?
item.description: Digital healthcare presents a dual landscape, offering innovative benefits while simultaneously imposing hurdles for various patients. Younger generations tend to embrace online health services with ease, yet reliable internet access and digital literacy remain essential for comprehensive medical support. Initiatives such as ABHA strive to digitally integrate healthcare systems. Ultimately, technology should serve to enhance, rather than substitute, the necessary human touch in patient care.

item.title: BJP, Congress trade barbs over PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi’s Indore event
item.description: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized the Congress party after a comedian mimicked Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This performance occurred during an event attended by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in Madhya Pradesh. Union ministers and other BJP leaders targeted the opposition party and the Congress MP over the skit. Congress leaders defended the program, stating that all mothers deserve respect and questioning BJP's selective outrage.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Italy to limit foreign students, ban burqa and hijab in schools
item.description: In a bold move, Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni unveiled new regulations for schools, prohibiting face coverings such as burqas and niqabs in classrooms. The initiative also sets a limit on foreign students per class and requires parents of foreign students to learn Italian, promoting integration and ensuring that Italian children feel at home, rather than a minority in their own schools.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Hidden cameras, dark web: Self-styled godman held in TN for sexually abusing women
item.description: Authorities took a self-proclaimed godman into custody after uncovering disturbing allegations of sexual abuse towards women and minors. This heinous act came to light following an attempted assault on a schoolgirl who was fundraising. Investigators discovered more than fifty explicit videos stored on his laptop, with Vijayaraja admitting to selling these recordings to an online platform for profit.
item.dc:creator: ANJALI SINGH

item.title: ‘Path of deception closed’: Iran vows ‘no limits’ in retaliation if US attacks
item.description: Iran has issued a stern warning, promising unlimited retaliation and a decisive conflict if the US attacks or dismisses its demands. Through Qatari mediators, Tehran has proposed seven conditions for a truce to Washington. Officials in Iran stressed that any regional nations supporting the US would be drawn into the conflict. Parliament speaker Ghalibaf reiterated the dual approach of military readiness alongside diplomatic negotiations.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: How TTD plans to unlock value from land and strengthen its financial systems
item.description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India is working with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams on several key projects. These initiatives include monetizing land assets through real estate investment trusts and valuing gold holdings. An updated accounting manual for the temple trust is also nearing completion by the institute. This comprehensive manual will cover all aspects of TTD's financial operations and collections.

item.title: Asian Games Day 1 Medal Tally: Where India rank after two silvers in Aichi-Nagoya
item.description: India made a striking start at the Asian Games, capturing two silver medals in shooting events. Elavenil Valarivan was a standout, winning silvers both individually and as part of the team in the 10m air rifle competition. Additionally, the women's cricket team powered through to the finals, showcasing their strength, along with commendable starts from the hockey and table tennis teams, who also secured significant victories.

item.title: 'Brahmastra' actor in judicial custody after woman files complaint over marriage promise
item.description: Saurav Gurjar, known for his role in Mahabharat, has been placed in judicial custody following allegations from a woman who claims he deceived and harassed her under false promises of marriage. After meeting on Instagram and developing a relationship via WhatsApp, they lived together in the US and India, where Gurjar allegedly persuaded her to leave her job. Police have initiated an investigation into the actor's actions.
